root.name: アルトリア・グループ

companies.name: 日本たばこ産業
companies.sub: 加熱式たばこの合弁相手

relations.text: 米国の加熱式たばこ事業を担う合弁会社ホライズンの残り25%を、JTの子会社が持つ
relations.text_en: A subsidiary of Japan Tobacco holds the remaining 25% of the Horizon joint venture

source.label: アルトリア 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: At December 31, 2025, we owned a 75% economic interest in Horizon Innovations LLC (“Horizon”), a joint venture with JTI (US) Holding, Inc. (“JTIUH”), a subsidiary of Japan Tobacco Inc. (“Japan Tobacco”), which owned the remaining 25% economic interest

companies.name: フィリップ モリス インターナショナル

relations.text: IQOSの米国での独占販売権をPMIに譲渡した
relations.text_en: Altria assigned the exclusive U.S. commercialization rights to the IQOS system to PMI

source.label: アルトリア 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: In April 2024, we assigned the exclusive U.S. commercialization rights to the IQOS Tobacco Heating System (“ IQOS System”) to Philip Morris International Inc. (“PMI”) pursuant to the terms of a purchase agreement entered into with PMI in October 2022

companies.name: アンハイザー・ブッシュ・インベブ

relations.text: ABIに出資し、持分法で会計処理している
relations.text_en: Altria invests in ABI and accounts for it under the equity method

source.label: アルトリア 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Our investments include Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV (“ABI”) and Cronos Group Inc. (“Cronos”), which we account for under the equity method of accounting using a one-quarter lag

relations.text: カナダの大麻関連企業クロノスに出資している
relations.text_en: Altria holds an investment in Cronos, a Canadian cannabinoid company

source.label: アルトリア 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Our investment in Cronos, a Canadian cannabinoid company, subjects us to various risks relating to Cronos’s business, such as legal, regulatory and reputational risks

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
